counting: Cached input is a subset of input. Reasoning is a subset of output. Total=input+output; subsets are not added twice. Own cumulative session totals have no inherited assignment counters. No nested agents/jobs/models. Parent orchestration usage is separate and not measured here.
unmeasuredTail: Tokens after the indicated telemetry cutoff, including this tool result and final report; platform overhead is not measured. Do not add cumulative and delta as independent usage.
